finding: The blend model predicts HWCS NMSE EQUALS the G16/G4 mixture (max deviation 2.22e-16), NOT below it. The quality gate 'HWCS below mixture' is therefore NOT satisfied by prediction.
implication: Any quality ADVANTAGE (HWCS below mixture) requires negative within-parent cross-terms (s2<s1), which is scene-dependent (correction C3) and NOT guaranteed. The blend gives equality; advantage is a possibility to be tested on REAL gradients, not a prediction.
stage_b_min_test: Stage B-min must measure REAL HWCS NMSE and compare to the per-seed G16/G4 mixture (paired CI). HWCS < mixture with CI excluding 0 => scene-dependent advantage realized. HWCS ≈ mixture => blend confirmed, no quality edge (but cost edge may still exist vs N1). HWCS > mixture => negative result, DROP quality claim.
